title: iPhone Duo arrives at Apple Store locations worldwide

claims.claim: iPhone Duo, 23 Ekim Cuma günü dünya genelindeki Apple Store mağazalarında satışa sunuldu.

evidence.quote: On Friday, October 23, the highly anticipated iPhone Duo made its debut at Apple Store locations worldwide.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo, Apple'ın ilk katlanabilir iPhone modelidir.

evidence.quote: Across the globe, customers filled stores and team members invited them to experience the first foldable iPhone, offering hands-on demos and personalized shopping support.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo; Apple Store mağazalarından, apple.com adresinden ve Apple Store uygulamasından satın alınabilir.

evidence.quote: Customers can explore and shop for the revolutionary iPhone Duo and the incredible iPhone lineup at Apple Store locations around the world, on apple.com, and in the Apple Store app.

claims.claim: Apple, müşterilere Apple Trade In, aylık kiralama seçenekleri, Apple Upgrade ve Apple Card Taksitli Ödeme gibi finansal seçenekler sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Dedicated Apple Specialists are available to provide world-class support, from maximizing value with Apple Trade In and monthly leasing options with Apple Upgrade, to Apple Card Monthly Installments and exceptional carrier deals.

claims.claim: Apple Store mağazalarında 'Say Hello to iPhone Duo' ve 'Tips: What’s New in iOS 27 on iPhone' başlıklı yeni Today at Apple oturumları düzenlenmektedir.

evidence.quote: and with new Today at Apple sessions including “Say Hello to iPhone Duo” and “Tips: What’s New in iOS 27 on iPhone,” they can take their passions further with the products they love.
